youtube_title: Red, Burning Skin After A Beach Day? Don't Make It Worse | Body Fix #49 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #49. Goa trip, all day on the beach, now your shoulders are RED and burning? And you said you never burn!
B is right. Cool shower + moisturise. Cool the skin, stay out of the sun.
Yes, brown skin burns too. And sun damage adds up over YEARS.
Fix: Cool compress, aloe or gentle cream, extra water, sunscreen + cap next time.
Red flags: Large blisters, fever, chills, dizziness or lots of swelling? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Sunburn
